context.paragraph: runtime/probe.c#parse_begin enables a fixed C buffer; runtime/probe.c#parse_end disables recording before constructing Python objects. At most 24,000 checkpoints are retained, with a dropped count for the omitted suffix. Text is bounded to 383 bytes and decoded with replacement if truncation splits UTF-8. Capture does not allocate Python objects in the hooks or abort parsing when this budget is reached. The runtime is a fresh, single-worker interpreter per run; the observer is process-global rather than a public thread-safe tracing API.
